method: For an early target prediction, a correct prediction receives the observed correct8 median total saving and a wrong prediction receives the observed correct0 median total penalty. Solve p*save-(1-p)*penalty > 0.
limits: The correct8 scheduler-inclusive saving has a bootstrap interval crossing zero, so the median threshold is a planning bound rather than repeatable end-to-end proof.
This is an eight-hint same-mm experiment; hundreds of wrong full-line replays can have nonlinear cache-pollution and bandwidth cost.
Line accuracy within the predicted context is separate from target-context prediction accuracy.
